admin.code.reveal: Connection code for {workspace}. It is shown only once; write it down now.
admin.code.revealHint: Codes only work while {setting} is turned on for the workspace. New computers normally pair instead, and an administrator approves them on the Devices page.
admin.devices.allowMergeHint: It may keep them and add them to the workspace, alongside the workspace’s own.
admin.devices.approved: {device} is paired and has joined {workspace}. The computer finishes setting itself up; nothing more is needed here.
admin.devices.emptyLibrary: The Church Library is empty, so this computer will have only the songs of the workspace it joins.
admin.devices.emptyLibraryNoContent: The Church Library is empty and this workspace has no content yet, so this computer will start with no songs at all.
admin.devices.mergeLegend: If this computer already has songs and run sheets of its own
admin.devices.name: Device name
admin.devices.noMergeHint: They are replaced by the workspace’s copy, so the workspace receives nothing from it, even when the workspace has no content yet. A backup stays on the computer.

admin.devices.none: No device has access to a workspace.

admin.devices.notPending: The request {code} is no longer pending. Requests last fifteen minutes; it may have expired, or another administrator handled it. Ask the computer to start pairing again if it still needs to join.
admin.devices.refuseText: The computer showing code {code} is told it was refused and does not join. It can start pairing again later.
admin.devices.revokeText: The device is disconnected and can no longer reach {workspace}. Its copy of the content stays on it. To join again it must pair or use a connection code, like a new device.
admin.error.files-removed: Files were removed, so this item cannot be restored.
